dict.string: The live tracker recognizes the people you have named, from the camera. Pictures stay on this Mac: only numbers are kept, unless you turn on Collect faces.
The live tracker can measure voice signals (loudness, pitch, speaking rate) from the microphone. Nothing is recorded.
Face Recognizer shows where this Mac is, to you and your other devices, and keeps its moves in your shared database, while you have switched that on.
